data.description: A clockwork mage's wand crystal allows it to cast spells as if using a spell trigger magic item. The arcane school of the wand crystal determines a clockwork mage's spells. They cast 1st-level spells at will, 2nd-level spells 3 times per day, and 3rd level spells 1 time per day.
data.name: Wand Magic
